THE BUILD

The thinking behind the page.

A useful project has to connect its interface to the visitor’s task.

Audience

People who need a clear path into Multi Tool Hub and an interface they can understand quickly.

Experience

Making each task discoverable from a shared index.

Next iteration

Review real visitor feedback and refine the areas where people hesitate or need more context.

Interface decisions

A collection of utilities works when each task is easy to find and fast to start. The index is part of the product.

What I would keep refining

Tool pages should use consistent labels and interaction patterns while still explaining their particular input and output.
